The CFO said Q2 2024 'GenAI contributions' exceeded expectations. No amount or share of revenue, ACV or bookings was given.

The May 2026 Analyst Day set a 2030 target of 30% of ACV from AI, alongside $30 billion+ of subscription revenue. Per the thesis, this is a plan for ACV mix, not a stated share of revenue, so no amount is derived.
